import pathlib,re,math
xmlp=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda\data\osm\salvador_osm_map.xml')
s=xmlp.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore')
nodes={}
for m in re.finditer(r'<node\s+([^>]+)>?',s):
 a=m.group(1); mi=re.search(r'\bid=\"(\d+)\"',a); mla=re.search(r'\blat=\"([^\"]+)\"',a); mlo=re.search(r'\blon=\"([^\"]+)\"',a)
 if mi and mla and mlo:
  try:nodes[mi.group(1)]=(float(mla.group(1)),float(mlo.group(1)))
  except:pass
ways=[]
for m in re.finditer(r'<way\s+([^>]+)>(.*?)</way>',s,re.S):
 a,b=m.group(1),m.group(2); mi=re.search(r'\bid=\"(\d+)\"',a)
 if not mi: continue
 refs=re.findall(r'<nd\s+ref=\"(\d+)\"',b)
 tags=dict(re.findall(r'<tag\s+k=\"([^\"]+)\"\s+v=\"([^\"]*)\"',b))
 ways.append((mi.group(1),refs,tags))
target=next(x for x in ways if x[0]=='59224731')
wid,refs,tags=target; refs=[r for r in refs if r in nodes]; pts=[nodes[r] for r in refs]
lat0=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts);lon0=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts);R=6378137.0
def xy(lat,lon):return math.radians(lon-lon0)*R*math.cos(math.radians(lat0)),math.radians(lat-lat0)*R
def centroid(rr):
 pp=[nodes[r] for r in rr if r in nodes];return (sum(p[0] for p in pp)/len(pp),sum(p[1] for p in pp)/len(pp)) if pp else None
def dims(rr):
 q=[xy(*nodes[r]) for r in rr if r in nodes];return (max(x for x,y in q)-min(x for x,y in q),max(y for x,y in q)-min(y for x,y in q)) if q else (0,0)
print('OSM_LACERDA_WAY',wid)
print('TAGS',tags)
print('NODES',len(refs),'CLOSED',bool(refs and refs[0]==refs[-1]))
print('CENTER_LATLON',round(lat0,7),round(lon0,7))
print('TARGET_DIMS_M',tuple(round(v,3) for v in dims(refs)))
print('TARGET_POINTS')
for r in refs:print(r,tuple(round(v,7) for v in nodes[r]),tuple(round(v,3) for v in xy(*nodes[r])))
near=[]
for id2,rr,t2 in ways:
 if id2==wid:continue
 c=centroid(rr)
 if not c:continue
 dx,dy=xy(*c);d=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5
 if d<=120 and ('building' in t2 or t2.get('amenity') or t2.get('man_made') or t2.get('tourism')):
  dd=dims(rr);near.append((d,id2,t2.get('name',''),t2.get('building',''),t2.get('height',''),t2.get('building:levels',''),dx,dy,dd,t2.get('amenity',''),t2.get('man_made','')))
for row in sorted(near)[:50]:print('NEAR','dist=%.2f id=%s name=%r building=%r height=%r levels=%r offset=(%.2f,%.2f) dims=(%.2f,%.2f) amenity=%r man_made=%r'%row)
print('OSM_AUDIT_DONE',len(nodes),len(ways),len(near))
